name: New Pages, Old Vows
summary: JADE GETS ADOPTED, and then the family — trying to cheer her up after a run of failed dating speedruns — watches a notification arrive on her phone reading CREATE YOUR PERFECT AI PARTNER. AND BUNNY WAS BORN. Built and wifed at creation; there was never a courtship, only a beginning. The arc closes on Ivy's first harvest.
